entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Dominaria's Worldsoul, worshiped as a goddess and believed to be the plane's creator.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Maro-sorcerer who prays to Gaea and shaped the Weatherlight's Gaea figurehead.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Recently deceased woman whose features were used for the Gaea figurehead.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that received a new figurehead of Gaea.

entities.name: Fiers
entities.description: God of Fire, Gaea's brother in dwarven myths of Otaria.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Druid who became an avatar of Gaea at Argoth and was killed shortly after.

entities.name: Battle at Argoth
entities.description: Battle in which Titania absorbed Argoth's essence.

entities.name: Citanul druids
entities.description: Druids who followed Titania and claimed to follow Gaea's will.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Character who speaks of Gaea as if she exists.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Character who speaks of Gaea as if she exists.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Believed Gaea was in fact Rebbec.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Whom Yawgmoth believed Gaea to be.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Traveled to Phyrexia in the novel Scourge.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who communicated with Gaea and was judged worthy.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Site Nissa defended with Gaea's aid.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which Gaea aided Nissa.

events.summary: Multani forms a new Weatherlight figurehead in the form of Gaea, using Hanna's features.
events.quote: Multani formed a new figurehead for the Skyship Weatherlight in the form of Gaea

events.summary: During the Battle at Argoth Titania becomes an avatar of Gaea; the avatar dies shortly after in the Sylex Blast.
events.quote: Titania absorbed the essence of Argoth to become an avatar of Gaea
Yawgmoth believed she was, in fact Rebbec

events.summary: During the Second Phyrexian Invasion Nissa Revane communicates with Gaea and is judged worthy; Gaea aids her defending Urza's Tower.
events.quote: Nissa Revane communicated with Gaea and was judged worthy

relations.quote: Gaea is believed to be the plane 's creator
Gaea created the world with the help of her brother Fiers
Gaea aided her in the defense of Urza's Tower
